title: Authority to Credit a Charge on a Rental of Safe Deposit Boxes
content:
Every credit against a rental of Safe Deposit Boxes is tied to the one charge it offsets and never exceeds that charge.

## Credit for a charge made in error

A bank-error credit reverses a charge made contrary to this charter: rent charged at the wrong branch adjustment, rent charged without the discount the lessee qualified for, or a late fee on rent that was paid within the grace days. There is no limit on credits of this kind.

## Courtesy credit of a late fee

A courtesy credit applies only to a late fee. It is available while the count of courtesy credits given over the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the current date, taken across that customer's rentals, remains below the allowance of such waivers set for that size.

## One credit per charge per reason

A charge can be credited at most once for the same reason. Whether a credit already stands against that charge for that reason is settled from the record of credits already made against it, read before a further credit is given.

## Credits arising from surrender and from a move

Credits for prorated rent, for the key deposit and for a move to another size arise on a surrender or on a move to another size, and are governed by the terms attaching to those events rather than by this basis.

## Points of judgement

A credit never exceeds the charge it offsets: a charge of $18.00, hypothetically, cannot carry a credit of more than $18.00, and a single credit cannot be spread across two charges, being tied to one.

The single-credit condition is set by charge and by reason together. Where a charge has already been credited in error correction, a second credit against that same charge for that same reason is not given; a credit for a different reason is not barred by this condition, though it remains bound by the rule that the credits against a charge never exceed it.

The courtesy allowance bears only on courtesy credits of a late fee. A credit given because the charge was contrary to this charter is not limited by that count, and it is available whatever the size of box and whatever courtesy credits the customer has already had.
